texts.facts: The petitioner submits that he is a retail seller of Ice cream who took a room for rent in the year 2024 from the 4 th respondent. Petitioner submits that he had obtained a licence from the Commissioner of Food Safety under the provisions of the FSSAI Act, 2006. Petitioner conceded that despite receiving Ext.P5 notice from the Municipality on 06.08.2024, directing him to function only with a trade licence, he has not stopped the business or applied for a licence. 2. Upon admission of the writ petition, an interim order was granted by this Court on 03.09.2024 and the same is still in force. The petitioners were served with Ext.P4 notice directing him to take a licence. Admittedly, the petitioners are functioning without a trade licence from the Municipality. The same person had filed Appeal No.136 of 2024 before the Tribunal. Both appeals were preferred against orders passed under Section 406(3) of the Kerala Municipality Act, alleging unauthorised constructions. The petitioner submits that he was granted a temporary licence for a temporary shed upto 31.03.2023 and thereafter, the Raveendranath @ Chefmaster Mohanan vs Food Safety Officer on 27 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126073255/ 9 Municipality was refusing to accept the application for renewal of licence submitted by the petitioner. 2. The Municipality had filed a counter, stating that proceedings were taken against the owner of the building alleging unauthorised constructions and they are pending before the Tribunal for Local Self Government Institutions. Admittedly, the petitioner is functioning without a trade licence from the Municipality.
